items.stem: Which of the following statements about the properties of water is incorrect?

options.text: Evaporation of water is effective to help cool the body of an organism.
Large volumes of water are slow to change temperature as the environmental temperature changes.
Ice (solid form of water) is denser than liquid water.
Water is a good solvent for ions and simple sugars

items.stem: Which of the following is the function of iron in mammals?

options.text: forming haemoglobin
forming cell membrane
for muscle contraction
forming bones

items.stem: Which of the following combinations about the function of the mineral is incorrect?

options.text: Mineral: calcium · Function: for forming teeth
Mineral: magnesium · Function: for blood clotting
Mineral: phosphate · Function: for forming nucleic acids
Mineral: iron · Function: for forming haemoglobin

items.stem: Which of the following combinations about the type of inorganic ion and its functions in plants and animals is incorrect?
